name: JoyAgent 智能体平台
desc: JD Cloud's platform for building and publishing enterprise agents
desc_zh: 京东云的企业智能体搭建与发布平台
solves: Enterprise workflows need models, knowledge and approvals wired together. JoyAgent assembles them and publishes to IM channels.
solves_zh: 企业里的流程要把模型、知识库和审批串起来。它把这些拼成智能体，一键发到企业微信、钉钉等渠道。
best_for: An HR team wants a policy bot inside the IM app staff already use.
best_for_zh: HR 想把制度问答机器人放进员工每天必开的 IM 里的时候。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://www.jdcloud.com/ product menu, https://joyagent.jd.com/ and https://）。 JoyAgent 3.0 was announced 2025-09-25/26 and open-sourced parts (JoyAgent-JDGenie, DataAgent, DCP); versions are not separate products. The joyagent.jd.com/pl page also lists JoyClaw 专业版 (京东个人 AI 助手, 2026.3.13 产品), JoyContext 知识库 (2025.12.30) and JoyCode — no first-party dated sentence was read for any of them, so they stay in report 'unconfirmed'. Distinct from the ledger entry 言犀智能体平台 (2024-07-30). Outside the 2026-05-07 window: proposed as a backfill. 首次公开日期来源：https://docs.jdcloud.com/cn/agents/product-introduce
